headline: Sales Manager @ ACR Electronics, Inc.
about: As a sales manager at ACR Electronics, Inc., I strive to achieve and exceed sales, customer satisfaction, and retention metrics. I also leverage my domain expertise as a General and Commercial Aviation Professional to provide innovative and customized solutions for clients in the aerospace, industry. With a master's degree in aviation and transportation from Lewis University, I have a strong foundation in the principles and practices of logistics, safety management, and project management in the aviation sector. I am passionate about applying my problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills to create value and impact for my organization and customers. My goal is to pursue professional endeavors that challenge and grow me as an aviation and transportation professional.… more
